description.zh: 下单成功后接住用户情绪的收尾页：用明确的成功状态、订单号与交付时间先给出确定感，再列商品明细、 金额与下一步动作（发票、物流、继续购物）。它不收集新信息，只把「钱已付、货在路上」讲清楚。
description.en: The closing screen after a successful purchase: a clear success state, order number and delivery estimate give certainty first, then item details, totals and next actions such as invoice, tracking or continue shopping. It collects nothing new — it exists to make paid-and-on-its-way unmistakable.

use_when.zh: 支付或下单成功后立即展示
use_when.en: Shown immediately after a successful payment or order

use_when.zh: 需要给出订单号与交付预期
use_when.en: The order number and delivery estimate must be stated

use_when.zh: 需要引导配送跟踪、发票或继续购物
use_when.en: Users should be guided to tracking, invoice or more shopping

avoid_when.zh: 支付失败或订单待审核（用状态或错误页）
avoid_when.en: Payment failed or pending review — use a status or error page

avoid_when.zh: 只是暂存草稿，尚未真正成单
avoid_when.en: Only a saved draft, not a real placed order

avoid_when.zh: 仍需用户继续填写信息
avoid_when.en: More user input is still required

note.zh: 明细与金额完整铺开，像一张电子小票
note.en: Full line items and totals, like a digital receipt

note.zh: 成功动效加简短摘要，适合消费品牌
note.en: Success motion with a short summary, for consumer brands

note.zh: 交付时间线与跟踪入口置于最前
note.en: Delivery timeline and tracking entry come first

anatomy: Order Meta 订单号与时间

note.zh: 图标加一句确认语，第一眼就知道成单了。
note.en: Icon plus one confirmation line so success reads instantly.

note.zh: 订单号、下单时间与预计送达，可一键复制。
note.en: Order number, timestamp and ETA, copyable in one click.

note.zh: 缩略图、规格、数量与单价逐项列出。
note.en: Each item with thumbnail, variant, quantity and unit price.

note.zh: 已下单、已付款、已发货、已送达的进度。
note.en: Progress through placed, paid, shipped and delivered.

note.zh: 查看订单、下载发票、继续购物，主次分明。
note.en: View order, download invoice, continue shopping — ranked clearly.

notes.zh: 成功横幅用 role="status" 让读屏播报结果；订单号提供复制按钮并给出已复制反馈。商品明细用列表或表格， 金额用等宽数字（font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums）右对齐。物流时间线用有序列表加伪元素连线； 庆祝动效须尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，并乘 --demo-speed。
notes.en: Announce the result with role="status" on the banner; give the order number a copy button with copied feedback. List or table line items with right-aligned tabular numerals for totals. Build the delivery timeline from an ordered list with pseudo-element connectors; celebratory motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion and scale with --demo-speed.

basic.zh: 创建一个订单确认页，显示成功状态、订单号、商品明细和金额。
basic.en: Create an order confirmation page showing success, the order number, item details and totals.

design.zh: 创建电商订单确认页：顶部成功横幅（图标加「支付成功」加可复制订单号）；中部订单摘要卡（下单时间、 预计送达）与商品明细列表；右栏或下方金额摘要（小计、运费、优惠、合计）；底部物流时间线与 「查看订单 / 下载发票 / 继续购物」按钮。移动端单列，深浅色一致。
design.en: Build a commerce order confirmation: a success banner on top (icon, payment-complete label, copyable order number); a summary card with time and ETA plus an item list; totals (subtotal, shipping, discount, total) in a right column or below; a delivery timeline and View order, Download invoice and Continue shopping buttons. Single column on mobile, consistent light/dark.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现订单确认页：从路由参数或订单接口取数据；订单号复制用剪贴板 API 并给出反馈； 金额计算抽成纯函数并用 tabular-nums 对齐；物流时间线为有序列表；庆祝动效可关闭且尊重 reduced-motion； 提供打印样式；不新增依赖。
implementation.en: Implement with React + Tailwind: read data from route params or the order API; copy the order number via the Clipboard API with feedback; pure-function totals with tabular-nums; an ordered-list delivery timeline; celebratory motion that can be disabled and respects reduced-motion; print styles; no new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现订单确认页。

先检查订单数据结构、支付回调与现有卡片和时间线组件，保持一致。
要求：
- 成功状态用 role="status" 播报
- 订单号可复制并给出已复制反馈
- 商品明细与金额摘要完整，金额用等宽数字右对齐
- 物流时间线用有序列表表达进度
- 庆祝动效尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 深浅色与打印样式一致，不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the order confirmation page in the current project.

Inspect the order data model, payment callback and existing card/timeline components; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Announce success with role="status"
- Copyable order number with copied feedback
- Full item details and totals with tabular right-aligned numbers
- Delivery timeline as an ordered list
- Celebratory motion respects prefers-reduced-motion
- Consistent light/dark and print styles; no new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
